subject: Human Body
title: How Scars Form
description: A quick win: understand How Scars Form.

hook.text: A scar isn't a flaw in healing.

buildup.text: During repair, collagen is laid down quickly in parallel bundles.

discovery.text: Scars lack hair follicles, sweat glands, and nerve endings.

twist.text: Fetal skin heals without scarring up to the third trimester.

climax.text: Scarring is the body's trade-off: fast closure at the cost of structural quality.

punchline.text: Scars trade quality for speed. Closing the wound matters most.

quiz.question: How does scar collagen differ from normal skin collagen?
options: Scar collagen is arranged in parallel bundles, not basket-weave
Scar collagen is made from a different protein
Scar collagen is thicker and more elastic
